check.name: street: armed, two lookouts out front

eval: (async () => { const g = window.__app.game; for (const id of ['look1','look2']) { const n = g.npcs.get(id); g.local.teleport(n.body.pos.clone().add({x: -6, y: 0, z: -1}), Math.PI / 2); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && n.alive; i++) { g.guns.reloadT = 0; g.guns.ammo = 30; g['localShoot'](n, n.body.chest().sub(g.local.body.chest()).normalize()); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 160)); } } return ['look1','look2'].map(id => g.npcs.get(id).alive); })()

check.name: they shoot back (someone got hit or shots fired)

eval: (async () => { const g = window.__app.game; g.local.regen = true; const ids = ['kessler','moreno1','moreno2','g4','g5','g6','g7']; for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) for (const id of ids) { const n = g.npcs.get(id); if (!n.alive) continue; g.local.body.hp = 100; const offs = [{x: 0, y: 0, z: -2.2}, {x: -2.2, y: 0, z: 0}, {x: 2.2, y: 0, z: 0}, {x: 0, y: 0, z: 2.2}]; g.local.teleport(n.body.pos.clone().add(offs[k % 4]), 0); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); for (let i = 0; i < 12 && n.alive; i++) { g.guns.reloadT = 0; g.guns.ammo = 30; g['localShoot'](n, n.body.chest().sub(g.local.body.chest()).normalize()); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); } } return ids.map(id => g.npcs.get(id).alive); })()
